Subject: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Hi Alex - thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can run an initial pricing sketch:

- Use case summary: customer-facing help assistant + search/rerank for internal docs; embeddings for semantic search and reranking; occasional long-form generation for summaries.
- Primary constraints: staying within a proof-of-value budget for the next 3 months, and predictable per-call latency (p95 < 450ms).

Could you confirm the following so we can finalize a provisional quote?
1) Estimated monthly token volumes by model type (chat / embeddings / rerank). If you have per-call token averages that's even better.
2) Any target budget range for the PoV (monthly) and any hard limits on $/1M tokens you need us to hit to be viable.
3) Preference on model variants (open/chat vs. gptx-style proprietary) and whether embeddings will be single-vector per doc or aggregate.

I attached a quick token-estimates template - if you fill that and send back I'll push a provisional pricing sketch to you tomorrow.

Next steps: you fill the sheet -> I run unit economics and propose model-mix pricing + recommended runway (cache/batch/quantization levers).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Cc: BrightLayer Procurement <procure@brightlayer.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-20T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the template. Filled the sheet and included a couple of notes inline. Key numbers below (monthly):

- Chat / generation (customer-facing assistant): ~150,000,000 tokens/month (avg ~400 tokens per session, ~375k sessions/mo).
- Embeddings (semantic search + vector store updates): ~45,000,000 tokens/month (approx 1 vector per doc, 1536-dim vectors; we do nightly re-embeds for changed content).
- Rerank / scoring (short context + rerank step): ~10,000,000 tokens/month (avg 60 tokens per rerank).
- Total: ~205,000,000 tokens/month.

Model mix preference: start with open chat models for assistant (lower cost, acceptable latency) but we may want to evaluate higher-quality chat model variants for a subset of traffic (10-15% can be higher-tier). Embeddings: prefer high-dim (1536) for accuracy. Rerank: lightweight model OK.

Budget constraints: for the PoV our procurement/finance team has set a target run rate of $2,500 - $4,000 / month. That equates to a target blended price of roughly $12 - $20 per 1M tokens given our volumes (we did the math: $2.5k / 205M ~= $12.2 per 1M; $4k / 205M ~= $19.5 per 1M). If you can show a pricing path that hits ~$12/1M or better with caching/batching and a hybrid model mix (open + a small % of higher-tier), we can proceed quickly.

Procurement also asked for any minimum committed tiers you recommend for a predictable SLA and to reduce unit costs.

Attached: filled token-estimates (sheet) and a short note from finance about the target range.

- Alex Johnson
Head of AI Product | BrightLayer
alex.johnson@brightlayer.com

Attachment: brightlayer_mvp_token_estimates.xlsx (updated)
Attachment: brightlayer_finance_note.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-20T18:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Alex - perfect, thanks for the detail. I ran a quick back-of-envelope with Mateo and here are the actionable options we can propose for the PoV:

1) Hosted (no commit) - Blended provisional price: $22 / 1M tokens. Expected monthly cost: ~$4,510 (good for fast start, no commit).
2) 3-month committed PoV (reserved capacity / modest commit) - Blended provisional price: $14 / 1M tokens. Expected monthly cost: ~$2,870. Includes SLA and 10% discount on higher-tier chat samples.
3) Dedicated starter pool (small Dedicated commit) - Blended provisional price: $10 / 1M tokens (requires 6-week provisioning lead time and a minimum monthly commit). Expected monthly cost: ~$2,050; best path for predictable latency and to hit your ~$12/1M target with a small QoS buffer.

Recommendations & levers:
- Model mix: route 75% of assistant traffic to open chat (cost-efficient), 15% to mid-tier chat for high-value flows, 10% to higher-tier for quality-sensitive queries. That aligns with your note about evaluating a small % of higher-quality calls.
- Embeddings: we can offer an optimized embedding profile for 1536-dim vectors with batching & caching; this typically reduces per-vector cost by ~20% compared to naive calls.
- Rerank: keep on lightweight models and reuse cached embeddings where possible.
- Quality run: include a small eval set to track regression if we do any quantization.

Next steps: If you want the $2,500/month target, option (2) gets you close ($2,870) and is the fastest operationally. Option (3) is the only one that reliably hits $10/1M but requires a short provisioning window and a commit.

Would you like a formal quote and a draft mutual action plan? If yes I'll loop legal and procurement and share a DocuSign for the 3-month PoV option.

Thanks,
Marissa
